title: netsh.exe "interface show interface" executed from cmd chain (network configuration discovery)
source: ML-style review of Wazuh archives.json (events with no corresponding alerts.json entry)
description: netsh.exe `interface show interface` spawned from `cmd /c ipconfig /all & netsh interface show interface & arp -a & nbtstat -n & net config ...`. Sibling commands (ipconfig, arp, nbtstat, net config) were alerted but netsh.exe was not. Network Setup Service (System EID 7036) starts/stops within 3 s of each netsh run – corroborating context.
why_wazuh_missed: No Wazuh rule for netsh.exe used for read-only network discovery.
detection_hints_for_rule: Sysmon EID 1: image endswith \netsh.exe AND commandLine matches (?i)interface\s+(ip\s+)?show|firewall\s+show|wlan\s+show
parentImage endswith \cmd.exe and parentCommandLine contains ipconfig AND netsh AND arp (chained discovery commands)
